summary: InMode Ltd. (INMD) filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, reporting Q1 2026 results and two abrupt departures: Dr. Michael Anghel resigned as Chairman (effective May 5, 2026) and Yair Malca resigned as CFO (effective May 5, 2026). Both resignations were stated as not due to any disagreement with the company. Dr. Hadar Ron was appointed Interim Chair. Mr. Malca will serve as a consultant for at least six months during a transition period, receiving full salary, insurance, and benefits. The filing also notes a previously authorized share repurchase program and routine legal proceedings. These forced/abrupt departures constitute the special situation.
